sEn: We propose penalizing the gradient norm of the critic with respect to its input, which stabilizes GAN training and avoids issues caused by weight clipping in WGAN.
sZh: 我们提出对判别器关于输入的梯度范数进行惩罚，从而稳定GAN训练，避免WGAN中权重裁剪导致的问题。
absEn: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) are powerful generative models, but suffer from training instability. The recently proposed Wasserstein GAN (WGAN) makes progress toward stable training of GANs, but sometimes can still generate only low-quality samples or fail to converge. We find that these problems are often due to the use of weight clipping in WGAN to enforce a Lipschitz constraint on the critic, which can lead to undesired behavior. We propose an alternative to clipping weights: penalize the norm of gradient of the critic with respect to its input. Our proposed method performs better than standard WGAN and enables stable training of a wide variety of GAN architectures with almost no hyperparameter tuning, including 101-layer ResNets and language models over discrete data. We also achieve high quality generations on CIFAR-10 and LSUN bedrooms.
absZh: 生成对抗网络（GAN）是强大的生成模型，但面临训练不稳定的问题。近期提出的Wasserstein GAN（WGAN）在稳定GAN训练方面取得了进展，但有时仍只能生成低质量样本或无法收敛。我们发现这些问题通常源于WGAN中为了对判别器施加Lipschitz约束而使用的权重裁剪，这可能导致不良行为。我们提出一种替代权重裁剪的方法：惩罚判别器关于其输入的梯度范数。我们提出的方法优于标准WGAN，并且能够在几乎不需要超参数调整的情况下稳定训练多种GAN架构，包括101层ResNet和离散数据上的语言模型。此外，我们在CIFAR-10和LSUN卧室数据集上生成了高质量图像。

contrib.zh: 提出梯度惩罚来强制 Lipschitz 约束，替代权重裁剪以实现稳定训练。

contrib.en: Enables stable training of diverse GAN architectures, including 101-layer ResNets and language models, with minimal tuning.

paras.en: Abstract Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) are powerful generative models, but suffer from training instability. The recently proposed Wasserstein GAN (WGAN) makes progress toward stable training of GANs, but sometimes can still generate only poor samples or fail to converge. We find that these problems are often due to the use of weight clipping in WGAN to enforce a Lipschitz constraint on the critic, which can lead to undesired behavior. We propose an alternative to clipping weights: penalize the norm of gradient of the critic with respect to its input. Our proposed method performs better than standard WGAN and enables stable training of a wide variety of GAN architectures with almost no hyperparameter tuning, including 101-layer ResNets and language models with continuous generators. We also achieve high quality generations on CIFAR-10 and LSUN bedrooms. †
paras.zh: 摘要 生成对抗网络（GAN）是强大的生成模型，但存在训练不稳定的问题。最近提出的Wasserstein GAN（WGAN）在稳定GAN训练方面取得了进展，但有时仍只能生成较差的样本或无法收敛。我们发现这些问题通常是由于WGAN中使用权重裁剪来对评论家施加Lipschitz约束，这可能导致不良行为。我们提出一种替代权重裁剪的方法：惩罚评论家相对于其输入的梯度范数。我们提出的方法优于标准WGAN，并且能够稳定训练多种GAN架构，几乎无需超参数调整，包括101层残差网络和具有连续生成器的语言模型。我们还在CIFAR-10和LSUN卧室数据集上实现了高质量生成。†

paras.en: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) [9] are a powerful class of generative models that cast generative modeling as a game between two networks: a generator network produces synthetic data given some noise source and a discriminator network discriminates between the generator's output and true data. GANs can produce very visually appealing samples, but are often hard to train, and much of the recent work on the subject [23, 19, 2, 21] has been devoted to finding ways of stabilizing training. Despite this, consistently stable training of GANs remains an open problem. In particular, [1] provides an analysis of the convergence properties of the value function being optimized by GANs. Their proposed alternative, named Wasserstein GAN (WGAN) [2], leverages the Wasserstein distance to produce a value function which has better theoretical properties than the original. WGAN requires that the discriminator (called the critic in that work) must lie within the space of 1-Lipschitz functions, which the authors enforce through weight clipping. Our contributions are as follows: 1. On toy datasets, we demonstrate how critic weight clipping can lead to undesired behavior. 2. We propose gradient penalty (WGAN-GP), which does not suffer from the same problems. 3. We demonstrate stable training of varied GAN architectures, performance improvements over weight clipping, high-quality image generation, and a character-level GAN language model without any discrete sampling. ∗ †
paras.zh: 生成对抗网络（GAN）[9]是一类强大的生成模型，将生成建模视为两个网络之间的博弈：生成器网络根据噪声源生成合成数据，判别器网络区分生成器的输出和真实数据。GAN可以生成视觉上极具吸引力的样本，但通常难以训练，并且最近关于该主题的大量工作[23, 19, 2, 21]致力于寻找稳定训练的方法。尽管如此，持续稳定的GAN训练仍然是一个开放问题。特别地，[1]分析了GAN优化值函数的收敛性质。他们提出的替代方案，称为Wasserstein GAN（WGAN）[2]，利用Wasserstein距离产生一个比原始值函数具有更好理论性质的值函数。WGAN要求判别器（在该工作中称为评论家）必须位于1-Lipschitz函数空间内，作者通过权重裁剪来强制执行。我们的贡献如下：1. 在玩具数据集上，我们展示了评论家权重裁剪如何导致不良行为。2. 我们提出梯度惩罚（WGAN-GP），它不会遭受同样的问题。3. 我们展示了多种GAN架构的稳定训练、优于权重裁剪的性能提升、高质量图像生成，以及无需任何离散采样的字符级GAN语言模型。∗ †

paras.en: The GAN training strategy is to define a game between two competing networks. The generator network maps a source of noise to the input space. The discriminator network receives either a generated sample or a true data sample and must distinguish between the two. The generator is trained to fool the discriminator. Formally, the game between the generator G and the discriminator D is the minimax objective: \(\min_G \max_D \mathbb{E}[\log(D(x))] + \mathbb{E}[\log(1 - D(\tilde{x}))]\), where G and D denote the generator and discriminator respectively.
paras.zh: GAN训练策略是定义两个竞争网络之间的博弈。生成器网络将噪声源映射到输入空间。判别器网络接收生成的样本或真实数据样本，并必须区分两者。生成器被训练以欺骗判别器。形式上，生成器G和判别器D之间的博弈是最小化极大目标：\(\min_G \max_D \mathbb{E}[\log(D(x))] + \mathbb{E}[\log(1 - D(\tilde{x}))]\)。

paras.en: where \(P_r\) is the data distribution and \(P_g\) is the model distribution implicitly defined by \(\tilde{x} = G(z), z \sim p(z)\) (the input z to the generator is sampled from some simple noise distribution p, such as the uniform distribution or a spherical Gaussian distribution). If the discriminator is trained to optimality before each generator parameter update, then minimizing the value function amounts to minimizing the Jensen-Shannon divergence between \(P_r\) and \(P_g\) [9], but doing so often leads to vanishing gradients as the discriminator saturates. In practice, [9] advocates that the generator be instead trained to maximize \(\mathbb{E}_{\tilde{x} \sim P_g}[\log(D(\tilde{x}))]\), which goes some way to circumvent this difficulty. However, even this modified loss function can misbehave in the presence of a good discriminator [1].
paras.zh: 其中\(P_r\)是数据分布，\(P_g\)是由\(\tilde{x} = G(z), z \sim p(z)\)隐式定义的模型分布（生成器的输入z从某个简单的噪声分布p中采样，例如均匀分布或球形高斯分布）。如果在每次生成器参数更新之前将判别器训练至最优，那么最小化价值函数等价于最小化\(P_r\)和\(P_g\)之间的詹森-香农散度[9]，但这通常会导致判别器饱和时梯度消失。在实践中，[9]建议转而训练生成器以最大化\(\mathbb{E}_{\tilde{x} \sim P_g}[\log(D(\tilde{x}))]\)，这在某种程度上可以规避这一困难。然而，即使这个修改后的损失函数在存在强判别器时也可能表现不佳[1]。

paras.en: [2] argues that the divergences which GANs typically minimize are potentially not continuous with respect to the generator’s parameters, leading to training difficulty. They propose instead using the Earth-Mover (also called Wasserstein-1) distance \(W(q, p)\), which is informally defined as the minimum cost of transporting mass in order to transform the distribution q into the distribution p (where the cost is mass times transport distance). Under mild assumptions, \(W(q, p)\) is continuous everywhere and differentiable almost everywhere. The WGAN value function is constructed using the Kantorovich-Rubinstein duality [25] to obtain \(\min_G \max_{D \in \mathcal{D}} \mathbb{E}_{x \sim P_r}[D(x)] - \mathbb{E}_{\tilde{x} \sim P_g}[D(\tilde{x})]\) (2), where \(\mathcal{D}\) is the set of 1-Lipschitz functions and \(P_g\) is once again the model distribution implicitly defined by \(\tilde{x} = G(z), z \sim p(z)\). In that case, under an optimal discriminator (called a critic in the paper, since it’s not trained to classify), minimizing the value function with respect to the generator parameters minimizes \(W(P_r, P_g)\). The WGAN value function results in a critic function whose gradient with respect to its input is better behaved than its GAN counterpart, making optimization of the generator easier. Empirically, it was also observed that the WGAN value function appears to correlate with sample quality, which is not the case for GANs [2]. To enforce the Lipschitz constraint on the critic, [2] propose to clip the weights of the critic to lie within a compact space \([-c, c]\). The set of functions satisfying this constraint is a subset of the k-Lipschitz functions for some k which depends on c and the critic architecture. In the following sections, we demonstrate some of the issues with this approach and propose an alternative.
paras.zh: [2]认为GAN通常最小化的散度可能关于生成器参数不连续，导致训练困难。他们建议改用推土机距离（也称为Wasserstein-1距离）\(W(q, p)\)，其非正式定义为将分布q转化为分布p所需的最小运输成本（成本为质量乘以运输距离）。在温和假设下，\(W(q, p)\)处处连续且几乎处处可微。WGAN价值函数利用Kantorovich-Rubinstein对偶性[25]构建，得到\(\min_G \max_{D \in \mathcal{D}} \mathbb{E}_{x \sim P_r}[D(x)] - \mathbb{E}_{\tilde{x} \sim P_g}[D(\tilde{x})]\) (2)，其中\(\mathcal{D}\)是1-Lipschitz函数集合，\(P_g\)再次是由\(\tilde{x} = G(z), z \sim p(z)\)隐式定义的模型分布。在这种情况下，在最优判别器（论文中称为评论家，因为它并非训练用于分类）下，相对于生成器参数最小化价值函数等价于最小化\(W(P_r, P_g)\)。WGAN价值函数产生的评论家函数关于其输入的梯度比GAN中的判别器更好，使得生成器优化更容易。实验还观察到，WGAN价值函数似乎与样本质量相关，而GAN则不然[2]。为了对评论家施加Lipschitz约束，[2]建议将评论家的权重裁剪到紧空间\([-c, c]\)内。满足该约束的函数集合是某个k-Lipschitz函数的子集，k取决于c和评论家架构。在接下来的章节中，我们将展示这种方法的一些问题并提出替代方案。

full.sec: 2.3 Properties of the optimal WGAN critic

paras.en: In order to understand why weight clipping is problematic in a WGAN critic, as well as to motivate our approach, we highlight some properties of the optimal critic in the WGAN framework. We prove these in the Appendix 2.
paras.zh: 为了理解权重裁剪在WGAN判别器中为何存在问题，并引出我们的方法，我们强调WGAN框架中最优判别器的一些性质。我们在附录2中证明了这些性质。

paras.en: Proposition 1. Let \(P_r\) and \(P_g\) be two distributions in \(X\), a compact metric space. Then, there is a 1-Lipschitz function \(f^*\) which is the optimal solution of \(\max_{\|f|_{L} \leq 1} \mathbb{E}_{y \sim P_r}[f(y)] - \mathbb{E}_{x \sim P_g}[f(x)]\). Let \(\pi\) be the optimal coupling between \(P_r\) and \(P_g\), defined as the minimizer of: \(W(P_r, P_g) = \inf_{\pi \in \Pi(P_r, P_g)} \mathbb{E}_{(x,y)\sim\pi}[\|x - y\|]\) where \(\Pi(P_r, P_g)\) is the set of joint distributions \(\pi(x, y)\) whose marginals are \(P_r\) and \(P_g\), respectively. Then, if \(f^*\) is differentiable, \(\pi(x = y) = 0\), and for \(x_t = (1-t)x + t y\) with \(0 \leq t \leq 1\), it holds that \(\mathbb{P}_{(x,y)\sim\pi} \nabla f^*(x_t) = \frac{y - x}{\|y - x\|}\).
paras.zh: 命题1：设\(P_r\)和\(P_g\)是紧度量空间\(X\)上的两个分布。那么存在一个1-Lipschitz函数\(f^*\)，它是以下问题的优化解：\(\max_{\|f|_{L} \leq 1} \mathbb{E}_{y \sim P_r}[f(y)] - \mathbb{E}_{x \sim P_g}[f(x)]\)。设\(\pi\)是\(P_r\)和\(P_g\)之间的最优耦合，定义为\(W(P_r, P_g) = \inf_{\pi \in \Pi(P_r, P_g)} \mathbb{E}_{(x,y)\sim\pi}[\|x - y\|]\)的极小化器，其中\(\Pi(P_r, P_g)\)是边缘分布分别为\(P_r\)和\(P_g\)的联合分布\(\pi(x, y)\)的集合。那么，如果\(f^*\)是可微的，则\(\pi(x = y) = 0\)，且对于\(x_t = (1-t)x + t y\)，\(0 \leq t \leq 1\)，有\(\mathbb{P}_{(x,y)\sim\pi} \nabla f^*(x_t) = \frac{y - x}{\|y - x\|}\)。

paras.en: Corollary 1. \(f^*\) has gradient norm 1 almost everywhere under \(P_r\) and \(P_g\).
paras.zh: 推论1：\(f^*\)在\(P_r\)和\(P_g\)下几乎处处具有梯度范数1。

paras.en: We find that weight clipping in WGAN leads to optimization difficulties, and that even when optimization succeeds the resulting critic can have a pathological value surface. We explain these problems below and demonstrate their effects; however we do not claim that each one always occurs in practice, nor that they are the only such mechanisms. Our experiments use the specific form of weight constraint from [2] (hard clipping of the magnitude of each weight), but we also tried other weight constraints (L2 norm clipping, weight normalization), as well as soft constraints (L1 and L2 weight decay) and found that they exhibit similar problems.
paras.zh: 我们发现WGAN中的权重裁剪会导致优化困难，即使优化成功，最终得到的评论家也可能具有病态的值曲面。我们在下文中解释这些问题并展示其影响；但我们并不声称每个问题在实践中总是发生，也不声称它们是唯一的机制。我们的实验使用了[2]中的特定形式的权重约束（每个权重大小的硬裁剪），但我们也尝试了其他权重约束（L2范数裁剪、权重归一化）以及软约束（L1和L2权重衰减），并发现它们表现出类似的问题。

paras.en: We observe that the WGAN optimization process is difficult because of interactions between the weight constraint and the cost function, which result in either vanishing or exploding gradients without careful tuning of the clipping threshold c. To demonstrate this, we train WGAN on the Swiss Roll toy dataset, varying the clipping threshold c in [10^{-1}, 10^{-2}, 10^{-3}], and plot the norm of the gradient of the critic loss with respect to successive layers of activations. Both generator and critic are 12-layer ReLU MLPs without batch normalization. Figure 1b shows that for each of these values, the gradient either grows or decays exponentially as we move farther back in the network. We find our method results in more stable gradients that neither vanish nor explode, allowing training of more complicated networks.
paras.zh: 我们观察到，由于权重约束与代价函数之间的相互作用，WGAN的优化过程较为困难，若不对剪切阈值c进行仔细调参，则会导致梯度消失或爆炸。为证明这一点，我们在瑞士卷玩具数据集上训练WGAN，将剪切阈值c在[10^{-1}, 10^{-2}, 10^{-3}]中变化，并绘制了判别器损失相对于连续激活层梯度的范数。生成器和判别器均为12层ReLU MLP，无批量归一化。图1b显示，对于每个取值，随着网络反向传播层数增加，梯度呈指数增长或衰减。我们发现，我们的方法产生的梯度更加稳定，既不会消失也不会爆炸，从而能够训练更复杂的网络。

paras.en: We now propose an alternative way to enforce the Lipschitz constraint. A differentiable function is 1-Lipschitz if and only if it has gradients with norm at most 1 everywhere, so we consider directly constraining the gradient norm of the critic's output with respect to its input. To circumvent tractability issues, we enforce a soft version of the constraint with a penalty on the gradient norm for random samples \(\hat{x} \sim P_{\hat{x}}\). Our new objective is \(L = \mathbb{E}_{\tilde{x} \sim P_g}[D(\tilde{x})] - \mathbb{E}_{x \sim P_r}[D(x)] + \lambda \mathbb{E}_{\hat{x} \sim P_{\hat{x}}}[\left(\|\nabla_{\hat{x}} D(\hat{x})\|_2 - 1\right)^2]\).
paras.zh: 我们现在提出一种实现Lipschitz约束的替代方法。一个可微函数是1-Lipschitz的当且仅当其梯度范数处处不超过1，因此我们考虑直接约束判别器输出相对于输入的梯度范数。为避免可处理性问题，我们采用软约束版本，对随机样本\(\hat{x} \sim P_{\hat{x}}\)的梯度范数施加惩罚。我们的新目标函数为 \(L = \mathbb{E}_{\tilde{x} \sim P_g}[D(\tilde{x})] - \mathbb{E}_{x \sim P_r}[D(x)] + \lambda \mathbb{E}_{\hat{x} \sim P_{\hat{x}}}[\left(\|\nabla_{\hat{x}} D(\hat{x})\|_2 - 1\right)^2]\).

paras.en: Sampling distribution We implicitly define \(P_{\hat{x}}\) sampling uniformly along straight lines between pairs of points sampled from the data distribution \(P_r\) and the generator distribution \(P_g\). This is motivated by the fact that the optimal critic contains straight lines with gradient norm 1 connecting coupled points from \(P_r\) and \(P_g\) (see Proposition 1). Given that enforcing the unit gradient norm constraint everywhere is intractable, enforcing it only along these straight lines seems sufficient and experimentally results in good performance. Penalty coefficient All experiments in this paper use \(\lambda = 10\), which we found to work well across a variety of architectures and datasets ranging from toy tasks to large ImageNet CNNs.
paras.zh: 采样分布 我们隐式定义\(P_{\hat{x}}\)为在从数据分布\(P_r\)和生成器分布\(P_g\)中采样的点对之间的直线上均匀采样。此方法的动机在于，最优判别器包含连接\(P_r\)和\(P_g\)的耦合点且梯度范数为1的直线（见命题1）。鉴于处处施加单位梯度范数约束难以处理，仅在这些直线上施加约束似乎足够，且实验结果表明性能良好。惩罚系数 本文所有实验均使用\(\lambda = 10\)，我们发现该值在从玩具任务到大型ImageNet CNN等各种架构和数据集上表现良好。

paras.en: No critic batch normalization Most prior GAN implementations [22, 23, 2] use batch normalization in both the generator and the discriminator to help stabilize training, but batch normalization changes the form of the discriminator's problem from mapping a single input to a single output to mapping from an entire batch of inputs to a batch of outputs [23]. Our penalized training objective is no longer valid in this setting, since we penalize the norm of the critic's gradient with respect to each input independently, and not the entire batch. To resolve this, we simply omit batch normalization in the critic in our models, finding that they perform well without it. Our method works with normalization schemes which don't introduce correlations between examples. In particular, we recommend layer normalization [3] as a drop-in replacement for batch normalization. Two-sided penalty We encourage the norm of the gradient to go towards 1 (two-sided penalty) instead of just staying below 1 (one-sided penalty). Empirically this seems not to constrain the critic too much, likely because the optimal WGAN critic anyway has gradients with norm 1 almost everywhere under \(P_r\) and \(P_g\) and in large portions of the region in between (see subsection 2.3). In our early observations we found this to perform slightly better, but we don't investigate this fully. We describe experiments on the one-sided penalty in the appendix.
paras.zh: 无判别器批归一化 大多数以往的GAN实现[22, 23, 2]在生成器和判别器中均使用批归一化以帮助稳定训练，但批归一化将判别器的问题形式从单输入到单输出的映射改变为整个批次输入到批次输出的映射[23]。在此设定下，我们的带惩罚的训练目标不再有效，因为我们独立地惩罚每个输入的判别器梯度范数，而非整个批次。为解决此问题，我们简单地在模型中的判别器中省略批归一化，并发现其在不使用批归一化时仍表现良好。我们的方法适用于不引入样本间相关性的归一化方案。特别地，我们推荐使用层归一化[3]作为批归一化的直接替代。双向惩罚 我们鼓励梯度范数趋向于1（双向惩罚），而非仅保持低于1（单向惩罚）。实验表明，这似乎并未过度约束判别器，可能是因为最优WGAN判别器在\(P_r\)、\(P_g\)以及两者之间大部分区域中梯度范数几乎处处为1（见第2.3节）。在我们早期的观察中，我们发现双向惩罚表现稍好，但我们并未进行充分研究。附录中描述了关于单向惩罚的实验。

full.sec: 5.2 Training varied architectures on LSUN bedrooms
full.secZh: 5.2 在 LSUN bedrooms 数据集上训练多种架构

paras.en: To demonstrate our model’s ability to train many architectures with its default settings, we train six different GAN architectures on the LSUN bedrooms dataset [31]. In addition to the baseline DCGAN architecture from [22], we choose six architectures whose successful training we demonstrate: (1) no BN and a constant number of filters in the generator, as in [2], (2) 4-layer 512-dim ReLU MLP generator, as in [2], (3) no normalization in either the discriminator or generator (4) gated multiplicative nonlinearities, as in [24], (5) tanh nonlinearities, and (6) 101-layer ResNet generator and discriminator. Although we do not claim it is impossible without our method, to the best of our knowledge this is the first time very deep residual networks were successfully trained in a GAN setting. For each architecture, we train models using four different GAN methods: WGAN-GP, WGAN with weight clipping, DCGAN [22], and Least-Squares GAN [18]. For each objective, we used the default set of optimizer hyperparameters recommended in that work (except LSGAN, where we searched over learning rates). For WGAN-GP, we replace any batch normalization in the discriminator with layer normalization (see section 4). We train each model for 200K iterations and present samples in Figure 2. We only succeeded in training every architecture with a shared set of hyperparameters using WGAN-GP. For every other training method, some of these architectures were unstable or suffered from mode collapse.

paras.en: The difference in performance between WGAN-P and other GANs can be explained as follows. Consider the simplex \(Delta_n = {p \in \mathbb{R}^n : p_i \geq 0, \sum_i p_i = 1}\), and the set of vertices on the simplex (or one-hot vectors) \(V_n = {p \in \mathbb{R}^n : p_i \in {0,1}, \sum_i p_i = 1} \subseteq \Delta_n\). If we have a vocabulary of size \(n\) and we have a distribution \(P_r\) over sequences of size \(T\), we have that \(P_r\) is a distribution on \(V_n^T = V_n \times \cdots \times V_n\). Since \(V_n^T\) is a subset of \(Delta_n^T\), we can also treat \(P_r\) as a distribution on \(Delta_n^T\) (by assigning zero probability mass to all points not in \(V_n^T\)). \(P_r\) is discrete (or supported on a finite number of elements, namely \(V_n^T\)) on \(Delta_n^T\), but \(P_g\) can easily be a continuous distribution over \(Delta_n^T\). The KL divergences between two such distributions are infinite, 8

full.sec: 5.6 Meaningful loss curves and detecting overfitting
full.secZh: 5.6 有意义的损失曲线与过拟合检测

paras.en: An important benefit of weight-clipped WGANs is that their loss correlates with sample quality and converges toward a minimum. To show that our method preserves this property, we train a WGAN-GP on the LSUN bedrooms dataset [31] and plot the negative of the critic's loss in Figure 5a. We see that the loss converges as the generator minimizes \(W(P_r, P_g)\). Given enough capacity and too little training data, GANs will overfit. To explore the loss curve's behavior when the network overfits, we train large unregularized WGANs on a random 1000-image subset of MNIST and plot the negative critic loss on both the training and validation sets in Figure 5b. In both WGAN and WGAN-GP, the two losses diverge, suggesting that the critic overfits and provides an inaccurate estimate of \(W(P_r, P_g)\), at which point all bets are off regarding correlation with sample quality. However in WGAN-GP, the training loss gradually increases even while the validation loss drops. [29] also measure overfitting in GANs by estimating the generator's log-likelihood. Compared to that work, our method detects overfitting in the critic (rather than the generator) and measures overfitting against the same loss that the network minimizes.
paras.zh: 权重裁剪的WGAN的一个重要优势是其损失与样本质量相关，并收敛到最小值。为了证明我们的方法保留了这一特性，我们在LSUN卧室数据集[31]上训练了WGAN-GP，并在图5a中绘制了判别器损失的负值。我们看到，当生成器最小化\(W(P_r, P_g)\)时，损失收敛。给定足够的容量和过少的训练数据，GAN会过拟合。为了探究网络过拟合时损失曲线的行为，我们在MNIST的随机1000张图像子集上训练了大型未正则化的WGAN，并在图5b中绘制了训练集和验证集上的判别器损失负值。在WGAN和WGAN-GP中，两个损失出现分歧，表明判别器过拟合并提供了不准确的\(W(P_r, P_g)\)估计，此时损失与样本质量的相关性不再可靠。然而在WGAN-GP中，即使验证损失下降，训练损失也逐步上升。[29]也通过估计生成器的对数似然来度量GAN的过拟合。与那项工作相比，我们的方法在判别器（而非生成器）中检测过拟合，并针对网络最小化的同一损失进行度量。

paras.en: In this work, we demonstrated problems with weight clipping in WGAN and introduced an alternative in the form of a penalty term in the critic loss which does not exhibit the same problems. Using our method, we demonstrated strong modeling performance and stability across a variety of architectures. Now that we have a more stable algorithm for training GANs, we hope our work opens the path for stronger modeling performance on large-scale image datasets and language. Another interesting direction is adapting our penalty term to the standard GAN objective function, where it might stabilize training by encouraging the discriminator to learn smoother decision boundaries. 9
paras.zh: 在这项工作中，我们展示了WGAN中权重裁剪的问题，并引入了一种替代方案，即在判别器损失中添加一个惩罚项，该惩罚项不会出现相同的问题。使用我们的方法，我们在多种架构上展示了强大的建模性能和稳定性。既然我们有了更稳定的训练GAN的算法，我们希望我们的工作为在大规模图像数据集和语言上实现更强的建模性能开辟了道路。另一个有趣的方向是将我们的惩罚项应用于标准GAN目标函数，这可能通过鼓励判别器学习更平滑的决策边界来稳定训练。9

paras.en: A Proof of Proposition 1 Proof. Since \(X\) is a compact space, by Theorem 5.10 of [25], part (iii), we know that there is an optimal \(f^*\). By Theorem 5.10 of [25], part (ii) we know that if \(\pi\) is an optimal coupling, \(\mathbb{P}_{(x,y)\sim \pi}[f^*(y) - f^*(x) = ||y-x||] = 1\). Let \((x,y)\) be such that \(f^*(y)-f^*(x)=||y-x||\). We can safely assume that \(x\neq y\) as well, since this happens under \(\pi\) with probability 1. Let \(\psi(t) = f^*(x_t) - f^*(x)\). We claim that \(\psi(t) = ||x_t - x|| = t||y-x||\). Let \(t,t_0\in[0,1]\), then \(|\psi(t)-\psi(t_0)| = ||f^*(x_t) - f^*(x_{t_0})|| \leq ||x_t - x_{t_0}|| = |t-t_0| ||x-y||\).
paras.zh: 命题1的证明。由于\(X\)是紧空间，根据[25]的定理5.10(iii)，存在最优的\(f^*\)。根据[25]的定理5.10(ii)，若\(\pi\)是最优耦合，则\(\mathbb{P}_{(x,y)\sim \pi}[f^*(y)-f^*(x)=||y-x||]=1\)。令\((x,y)\)满足\(f^*(y)-f^*(x)=||y-x||\)。我们还可安全地假设\(x\neq y\)，因为这在\(\pi\)下以概率1成立。令\(\psi(t)=f^*(x_t)-f^*(x)\)。我们断言\(\psi(t)=||x_t-x||=t||y-x||\)。取\(t,t_0\in[0,1]\)，则\(|\psi(t)-\psi(t_0)|=||f^*(x_t)-f^*(x_{t_0})||\leq||x_t-x_{t_0}||=|t-t_0|||x-y||\)。

paras.en: Therefore, \(\psi\) is \(||x-y||\)-Lipschitz. This in turn implies \(\psi(1)-\psi(0)=\psi(1)-\psi(t)+\psi(t)-\psi(0) \leq (1-t)||x-y||+\psi(t)-\psi(0) \leq (1-t)||x-y||+t||x-y||=||x-y||\). However, \(|\psi(1)-\psi(0)|=|f^*(y)-f^*(x)|=||y-x||\) so the inequalities have to actually be equalities. In particular, \(\psi(t)-\psi(0)=t||x-y||\), and \(\psi(0)=f^*(x)-f^*(x)=0\). Therefore, \(\psi(t)=t||x-y||\) and we finish our claim. Let \(\frac{y - x_t}{||y - x_t||} = \frac{y - ((1-t)x + t y)}{||y - ((1-t)x + t y)||} = \frac{(1-t)(y-x)}{(1-t)||y-x||} = \frac{y-x}{||y-x||}\).
paras.zh: 因此，\(\psi\)是\(||x-y||\)-Lipschitz的。这进而推出\(\psi(1)-\psi(0)=\psi(1)-\psi(t)+\psi(t)-\psi(0)\leq(1-t)||x-y||+\psi(t)-\psi(0)\leq(1-t)||x-y||+t||x-y||=||x-y||\)。然而，\(|\psi(1)-\psi(0)|=|f^*(y)-f^*(x)|=||y-x||\)，因此所有不等式必须实际成为等式。特别地，\(\psi(t)-\psi(0)=t||x-y||\)，且\(\psi(0)=f^*(x)-f^*(x)=0\)。因此，\(\psi(t)=t||x-y||\)，完成了断言。令\(\frac{y-x_t}{||y-x_t||}=\frac{y-((1-t)x+ty)}{||y-((1-t)x+ty)||}=\frac{(1-t)(y-x)}{(1-t)||y-x||}=\frac{y-x}{||y-x||}\)。

paras.en: Now we know that \(f^*(x_t) - f^*(x) = \psi(t) = t||x-y||\), so \(f^*(x_t) = f^*(x) + t||x-y||\). Then, we have the partial derivative \(\frac{\partial}{\partial v} f^*(x_t) = \lim_{h\to 0} \frac{f^*(x_t + h v) - f^*(x_t)}{h}\). With \(v = \frac{y-x}{||y-x||}\), we have \(x_t + h v = x + t(y-x) + \frac{h}{||y-x||}(y-x) = x + \left(t + \frac{h}{||y-x||}\right)(y-x)\). Hence \(f^*(x_t + h v) = f^*(x) + \left(t + \frac{h}{||y-x||}\right)||x-y|| = f^*(x) + t||x-y|| + h\). Therefore, \(\frac{f^*(x_t + h v) - f^*(x_t)}{h} = \frac{h}{h} = 1\), and \(\frac{\partial}{\partial v} f^*(x_t) = 1\).
paras.zh: 现在我们知道\(f^*(x_t)-f^*(x)=\psi(t)=t||x-y||\)，所以\(f^*(x_t)=f^*(x)+t||x-y||\)。于是，我们有方向导数\(\frac{\partial}{\partial v}f^*(x_t)=\lim_{h\to0}\frac{f^*(x_t+hv)-f^*(x_t)}{h}\)。取\(v=\frac{y-x}{||y-x||}\)，则\(x_t+hv=x+t(y-x)+\frac{h}{||y-x||}(y-x)=x+\left(t+\frac{h}{||y-x||}\right)(y-x)\)。因此\(f^*(x_t+hv)=f^*(x)+\left(t+\frac{h}{||y-x||}\right)||x-y||=f^*(x)+t||x-y||+h\)。所以\(\frac{f^*(x_t+hv)-f^*(x_t)}{h}=\frac{h}{h}=1\)，且\(\frac{\partial}{\partial v}f^*(x_t)=1\)。

paras.en: If \(f^*\) is differentiable at \(x_t\), we know that \(||\nabla f^*(x_t)|| \leq 1\) since it is a 1-Lipschitz function. Therefore, by simple Pythagoras and using that \(v\) is a unit vector, \(1 = \left|\frac{\partial}{\partial v} f^*(x_t)\right|^2 \leq ||\nabla f^*(x_t)||^2 \leq 1\), so equality holds.
paras.zh: 如果\(f^*\)在\(x_t\)处可微，由于它是1-Lipschitz函数，我们知道\(||\nabla f^*(x_t)||\leq1\)。因此，由简单的勾股定理，并注意到\(v\)是单位向量，有\(1=\left|\frac{\partial}{\partial v}f^*(x_t)\right|^2\leq||\nabla f^*(x_t)||^2\leq1\)，故等式成立。

paras.en: D Nonsmooth activation functions The gradient of our objective with respect to the discriminator's parameters contains terms which involve second derivatives of the network's activation functions. In the case of networks with ReLU or other common nonsmooth activation functions, this means the gradient is undefined at some points (albeit a measure zero set) and the gradient penalty objective might not be continuous with respect to the parameters. Gradient descent is not guaranteed to succeed in this setting, but empirically this seems not to be a problem for some common activation functions: in our random architecture and LSUN architecture experiments we find that we are able to train networks with piecewise linear activation functions (ReLU, leaky ReLU) as well as smooth activation functions. We do note that we were unable to train networks with ELU activations, whose derivative is continuous but not smooth. Replacing ELU with a very similar nonlinearity which is smooth (\text{softplus}(2x+2)-1\) fixed the issue.
paras.zh: D 非光滑激活函数 我们的目标函数关于判别器参数的梯度包含网络激活函数的二阶导数项。对于使用ReLU或其他常见非光滑激活函数的网络，这意味着梯度在某些点（尽管是零测集）未定义，且梯度惩罚目标可能关于参数不连续。在这种情况下，梯度下降不一定成功，但经验上，对于一些常见激活函数似乎不是问题：在我们的随机架构和LSUN架构实验中，我们发现能够训练具有分段线性激活函数（ReLU、Leaky ReLU）以及光滑激活函数的网络。我们确实注意到，我们无法训练使用ELU激活函数的网络，其导数连续但不光滑。将ELU替换为一个非常相似的光滑非线性函数（\text{softplus}(2x+2)-1\）解决了这个问题。

paras.en: The generator and critic are residual networks; we use pre-activation residual blocks with two 3 \times 3 convolutional layers each and ReLU nonlinearity. Some residual blocks perform downsampling (in the critic) using mean pooling after the second convolution, or nearest-neighbor upsampling (in the generator) before the second convolution.
